message: Target portfolio is available.
Security IDs are required.
Holdings must be unique by security_id.
Weights must be finite.
Long-only portfolio cannot have negative weights.
Weights sum to 1.000000.
Cross-listed securities must not create duplicate issuer exposure.
Every selected holding requires known sector metadata.
Every selected holding requires known country metadata.
Every selected holding requires known region metadata.
Every selected holding requires known currency metadata.
Selected holdings cannot carry Avoid or Exclude recommendations.
Synthetic metadata or fundamentals are allowed for testing but block deployment.
Final holdings must come from the strict hard-eligibility set.
The selected optimiser must report a feasible hard-constraint solution.
Current NAV should be positive when current portfolio is available.
expected_total_return must be finite.
p5_return must be finite.
p50_return must be finite.
p95_return must be finite.
Forecast quantiles require P5 <= P50 <= P95.
dividend_cut_probability must be between 0 and 1.
large_drawdown_probability must be between 0 and 1.
Expected Shortfall should be at least as severe as VaR under negative-loss convention.
Stress scenario names must be unique.
Stress losses should use negative-loss convention.
Regime probabilities must be between 0 and 1.
Seed results should be available when DRL is active.
Model run ID must be present.
